Bug_Details:
Avoid the use temporary objects when converting primitives to Strings. Use the static conversion methods
on the wrapper classes instead.
Examples:
public String convert(int x) {
    String foo = new Integer(x).toString(); // this wastes an object

    return Integer.toString(x);             // preferred approach
}
Bug_Explanation: The code converts an integer to a string using a temporary Integer object, which is unnecessary and inefficient. The line 'String result = new Integer(number).toString();' creates an unnecessary temporary Integer object to convert the int value to a String.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBugFails method is designed to fail by expecting a different result from the showBug method. This failure illustrates the inefficiency of the showBug method, highlighting the unnecessary creation of a temporary Integer object.
